reviews.title: Reliable, High-Quality webcam
reviews.comment:
The Logitech C922x HD Pro
Webcam has been a great upgrade for my setup. The video quality is very sharp and clear at 1080p, and the 720p at 60fps option is perfect for smoother video during calls or streaming. Colors look natural, and the automatic light correction does a great job even in lower lighting, which means I don't have to constantly adjust my room lighting.
Setup was quick and easy-plug and play with no issues on my computer. It works seamlessly with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, and the autofocus keeps the image crisp without annoying lag.
The built-in dual microphones also sound surprisingly clear for a webcam, making it great for meetings without external mic.
The build quality feels solid, and the adjustable clip mounts securely on my monitor. Overall, this webcam delivers excellent performance for the price and is a reliable choice for remote work, video calls, or content creation. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: ashley wallace

reviews.title: Great Webcam for Streaming and Video Calls!
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using the Logitech C922x Pro Stream Webcam, and it’s been awesome! The video quality is super clear at 1080p, perfect for streaming or video calls. Even in low light, the picture looks great, and the autofocus keeps everything sharp without me having to adjust anything.
It was super easy to set up—just plug it in, and you're good to go. I’ve used it mostly with Teams, and it works perfectly. The built-in mic is pretty solid, too. I use a headset/mic for the most part, You don’t necessarily need an external one unless you're looking for top-notch sound.
If you’re looking for a reliable, high-quality webcam for work, streaming, or just keeping in touch with friends, this one’s definitely worth it. I’m really happy with it!
reviews.author: Preston

reviews.title: This Completely Clobbers Built-Ins
reviews.comment: One of the best personal webcams for youtube or content creation at one of the more affordable prices still left on the market. Graphics while live streaming are very high quality with a sound too boot. Recorded content is amazing upon playback and with some simple software you can edit and adjust the very high quality that comes from this web camera, with ease. I've had a couple of these and they've both been amazing.
reviews.author: Marc BlacWater

reviews.title: Okay camera, Overpriced
reviews.comment: I think it is great. Software is simple enough to use with an okay amount of features to mess around with to however you like. The adjustability actually feels quite nice and stays very stable on top of my monitor but I wish there was a way to turn it a little left/right. The big drawback for this camera is the price point. It is very expensive for the way it looks. It is also getting quite old, it came out in 2016 and this camera is very overpriced, I think unless you are loyal to the Logitech brand there are many other options that are on par/better than this camera at a more reasonable price.
reviews.author: Danny

reviews.title: Solid webcam.
reviews.comment:
I recently purchased the Logitech C922x Pro Stream Webcam for use on our podcast, The Hunting Quest, and I must say it has exceeded our expectations. The full 1080p HD camera quality is outstanding, providing crisp and clear video for our viewers.
One of the standout features of this webcam is its low-light performance, which is essential for our podcasting setup. Even in dimly lit rooms, the C922x delivers impressive image quality, ensuring our audience can always see us clearly.
The webcam's built-in dual microphones capture audio with remarkable clarity, reducing the need for additional external microphones. This convenience has improved our podcasting workflow and minimized setup time.
Another feature we appreciate is the background removal tool, which allows us to use custom backgrounds during our recordings without the need for a green screen. It's a fun and professional touch that adds a lot of value to our content.
The Logitech C922x Pro Stream Webcam is not just a great choice for podcasting but also for live streaming, video conferencing, and content creation. It's versatile, easy to set up, and delivers exceptional performance, making it an excellent investment for anyone looking to enhance their visual presence online. We highly recommend it for podcasters and content creators alike.
